title: AI Instagram Ads for Reels, Stories and Feed | AIVideosUGC
description: Make an Instagram ad from one product photo. Choose a tall phone Reel or a square photo. You pay in credits, and you see the cost first. No watermark.
h1: AI Instagram Ads from One Product Photo
lead: Paste a product link or start from one photo. UGC means the ad looks like a customer filmed it. Pick a presenter made by AI (an actor) and a voice. A credit is what your plan spends on each file, and you see that cost first. Then publish the Instagram ad, or download it with no watermark.
card: Instagram ads from one product photo, as a tall clip or a square photo.

faq.q: What can I make here for Instagram?
faq.a: A tall phone clip for Reels and Stories, or a square photo for your profile, from a product link or one photo. You can add an actor, a script, a spoken voice, and captions. The credit cost shows first.

faq.q: How do I make an Instagram ad from a link?
faq.a: Paste the product page. A script, pictures, and captions can be drafted for you. Pick an actor and a voice, choose the tall clip or the square photo, then publish or download.

faq.q: Do you have ready-made Reel layouts?
faq.a: Yes. Start from a Reel, Story, or post template, then swap the product, the actor, and the line. You can also describe one moment with no template.
A photo costs 24 credits. A 6-second clip is 24 credits, 10 seconds is 40, 15 is 60, and 30 is 120. You see the price before you start. If a job fails, those credits come back on their own.

faq.q: Are music, captions and a voice included?
faq.a: Yes. A clip can include captions, a spoken voice, and a music track. Change them in the editor before you publish or download. The file has no watermark.

faq.q: Can I publish the file as a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. Publish it to Instagram or Meta (Facebook and Instagram's ad system) from here, or download it and upload it yourself. Follow the current review checks for the country where the ad will run.

faq.q: Do I need a creator or a studio?
faq.a: No. Pick someone from the actor library, or make a presenter that looks like you. If a person appears, that presenter is made by AI. It is not a real customer, and not a creator you booked.

faq.q: Which picture should I check before download?
faq.a: Compare your ad spot with [social media ad sizes](/guides/ad-sizes-by-platform), then preview the file so on-screen buttons do not cover the product.
